macros.name: Item to Journal

jack-small-details.description: Exports world items to JournalEntries grouped by root folder, with images and descriptions.

macros.name: Lock Token Rotation

jack-small-details.description: GUI para travar/destravar rotação de tokens em cenas selecionadas, com confirmação.

macros.name: Mass Scene Editor

jack-small-details.description: Edit shared settings (grid, lighting, weather, ambient sound) across multiple scenes at once.

macros.name: Ownership Manager

jack-small-details.description: Assign ownership levels in bulk to any document type. Supports folder tree navigation and per-user settings.

macros.name: Scene & Door Control

jack-small-details.description: Bulk manage doors (open/close/lock/secret) and Fog of War. Supports Mass Edit integration.

macros.name: Scene Rescaler

jack-small-details.description: Rescale scenes (grid, tokens, walls, lights, sounds, notes) preserving all IDs. Supports batch processing and compendium backup.

macros.name: Hide Camera Bar

jack-small-details.description: Mostra ou esconde a barra de câmeras AV. Avisa antes de agir e informa se o elemento não está disponível.
